home.practice_salvage_blurb: Drag a tether through matching debris and haul it in. Close the line into a loop to net every crate adrift.
salvage.title: Salvage
salvage.how_to: Drag a line through touching debris of one kind, diagonals included, and let go to haul it: a line of n pieces scores n times n. Loot crates cannot be tethered. A crate that sinks to the floor is taken for a little; to take crates for what they are worth, bring the line back onto its first piece. A closed line is a net: it hauls every crate on the field at once, and crates are worth far more together than apart.
salvage.how_to_keyboard: Arrows or WASD move the cursor, Q E Z C move it diagonally. Space starts a line, the cursor draws it, space or enter hauls it, escape drops it.
salvage.streak_note: A line of five or more builds a streak that multiplies every haul, up to double. One shorter line is forgiven; a second in a row breaks it.
salvage.coupler_note: A coupler joins any line, and the line may change kind across it.
salvage.hint_note: Practice rounds show a line worth drawing when you pause.
salvage.legend_debris: Debris: five kinds, each its own shape.
salvage.legend_crate: Loot crate. Cannot be tethered. A closed line nets every one on the field: one is worth 50, two 200, three 450.
salvage.legend_coupler: Coupler. Joins any line; the line may change kind across it.
salvage.legend_floor: The brass line is the floor. A crate that reaches it is taken for 30.
